findings.proposedFix: Point both mutations at the mounted capture route POST '/attendance' (captureHandler('attendance')), folding kind:'check-in'/'check-out' into the body to mirror the existing offline enqueueWrite('attendance', { ...input, kind }) — OR add explicit POST /attendance/check-in and /attendance/check-out handlers to estate-manager-app.ts. findings.title: Admin cross-tenant superpowers (suspend_tenant_org, force_password_reset, force_lease_termination, export_regulator_pack, etc.) NEVER execute — bulk-action + four-eye approve only write journal rows; no dispatcher/executor exists, so every approved admin verb is a silent no-op that reports 'Action applied'
findings.fileLine: services/api-gateway/src/routes/admin/superpowers.hono.ts:184-325 (POST /bulk-action — only undoJournal+pendingApprovals inserts, no side-effect; MEDIUM returns 'Action applied.'), :328-516 (POST /approve — only flips status='applied', no mutation fires)
findings.proposedFix: Wire an admin-verb dispatcher mirroring owner/superpowers/bulk-action-dispatchers.ts: MEDIUM verbs fire in POST /bulk-action; HIGH verbs fire inside POST /approve in the same tx immediately after the pending row transitions to 'applied'. Map each verb to its concrete mutation (suspend_tenant_org → tenants.status='suspended'; force_password_reset → identity reset; force_lease_termination → leases.status='terminated'; export_regulator_pack → regulator-export job; reactivate_tenant_org → status='active'). Until an executor exists, the route MUST NOT return status:'applied'/'Action applied' — return NOT_IMPLEMENTED/202-queued so the admin is not lied to. Cross-tenant mutations must run under withServiceRoleContext or an explicit target-tenant-bound tx, not the proposer's pinned-tenant tx.

findings.title: Orgs-signup→cockpit cookie rehydration seam is born-broken: gateway sets bossnyumba-session cookie but the owner cockpit reads session ONLY from localStorage bearer and never reads/sends the cookie — every new owner is bounced to /login right after signing up
findings.issueClass: FE↔BE integration-seam regression (half-wired auth handoff / silent no-op success)
findings.fileLine: apps/owner-portal/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx:59,182,241; apps/owner-portal/src/lib/api.ts:44-55 (no credentials:'include'); apps/owner-portal/src/App.tsx:218; SETTER: services/api-gateway/src/routes/orgs.hono.ts:200-218 + apps/marketing/src/components/auth/OwnerSignUpForm.tsx:106-108; gateway /auth/me bearer-only: services/api-gateway/src/routes/auth.ts:462 + middleware/hono-auth.ts:50-52
findings.proposedFix: Implement the missing cockpit-side rehydration. Either (A) on AuthProvider mount when localStorage.token is empty, call GET /auth/me with credentials:'include' AND teach /auth/me (or a dedicated /auth/session) to read the bossnyumba-session cookie and return a session, then persist access_token to localStorage; this also requires api.ts to send credentials:'include' and the cookie to be parent-domain scoped (see the host-only finding). Or (B) hand the access_token to the cockpit via a short-lived URL handoff the cockpit reads on /dashboard. Add an end-to-end test asserting a fresh signup lands AUTHENTICATED in the cockpit — current coverage (orgs-signup.test.ts asserts only Set-Cookie on the gateway; marketing page.test.tsx asserts only that the form mounts) never exercises the cockpit READ, which is why the seam shipped broken.

findings.title: Owner org-signup is born-broken: provisions a Supabase auth user + cookie session, but the owner-portal authenticates ONLY against a platform bcrypt password + HS256 localStorage token — the new owner can never log in

findings.title: M-Pesa B2C payout stranded in PROCESSING when no callback ever arrives — debited-but-undelivered money is fetched then filtered out, never swept
findings.issueClass: Half-state never driven to terminal / dependency-down (lost callback) traced to money loss
findings.fileLine: services/payments-ledger/src/jobs/disbursement-reconciliation.job.ts:142 (.filter(d => d.status === 'NEEDS_REVERSAL')); findPending returns PENDING/PROCESSING/IN_TRANSIT/NEEDS_REVERSAL at drizzle-disbursement.repository.ts:353-358; B2C createTransfer PENDING->PROCESSING at disbursement.service.ts:305-309

findings.title: Marketing signup POST defaults to same-origin /api/v1/orgs/signup which nginx routes to the marketing Next app (no such route → 404) — funnel works only if NEXT_PUBLIC_API_GATEWAY_URL is explicitly set at build time, and the 'same-origin proxy' the code comment claims does not exist

findings.title: Co-owner invite is two un-transacted writes: createInvite (DB row) then enqueueInviteEmail (queue) — a failure in the second leaves an orphaned pending invite while the owner is told 'Failed to send invitation' and retries into a duplicate
findings.fileLine: services/api-gateway/src/routes/owner/owner-account.hono.ts:307-352 (createInvite + getOwnerSettings + enqueueInviteEmail, no transaction; blanket 500 in catch) + services/api-gateway/src/routes/owner/owner-account-repo.ts:265-274 (plain INSERT, no ON CONFLICT) + packages/database/src/migrations/0335_co_owner_invites.sql:94-99 (only token is unique; no UNIQUE(tenant_id,email))
findings.proposedFix: Wrap createInvite + enqueueInviteEmail in one transaction so a failed enqueue rolls back the invite row, OR make createInvite idempotent on (tenant_id, lower(email)) where status='pending' so a retry reuses the existing row, OR on the enqueue-failure path revoke/delete the just-created invite before returning the error.

findings.title: bid_messages append-only / audit-grade invariant is only half-enforced — a BEFORE UPDATE trigger exists but no BEFORE DELETE, so a tenant can DELETE negotiation messages despite the documented immutability guarantee
findings.issueClass: half-wired safety guard / append-only invariant gap
findings.fileLine: packages/database/src/migrations/0328_bid_messages.sql:99-103 (only BEFORE UPDATE trigger) vs the DELETE-blocked claim at 0328:19 and 0328:88; tenant_isolation_bid_messages FOR ALL at 0328:128-133
findings.proposedFix: Add a BEFORE DELETE trigger in a new follow-on migration reusing the existing function: CREATE TRIGGER bid_messages_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON bid_messages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION bid_messages_immutable(). FK ON DELETE CASCADE from parent bids still works (row triggers do not fire on the referential CASCADE action — the intended cleanup path). Alternatively, if deletion-with-the-bid is the only intended removal, correct the 0328 comments at :19 and :88 to stop claiming DELETE is blocked.

findings.title: field/shifts 'today' is bucketed on the UTC calendar day, so a worker in the launch jurisdiction (Africa/Dar_es_Salaam, UTC+3) sees the wrong/empty shift during the 21:00-24:00 UTC window
findings.fileLine: services/api-gateway/src/routes/field/shifts.hono.ts:84-86 (UTC todayDateString) used at :157 (eq(staffShifts.shiftDate, today)) and :199-204 (maintenance_tasks due-today window)
findings.proposedFix: Resolve the calendar day in the tenant/worker IANA timezone rather than UTC: derive 'today' via Intl.DateTimeFormat (or a date lib) using the tenant's zone (owner_settings.timezone / region config, defaulting to Africa/Dar_es_Salaam), and apply the same zone to the maintenance_tasks due-today bounds at :199-204. Never hard-code an offset (multi-currency/multi-TZ hard rule).

findings.title: RFB create hard-codes a 'TZS' currency fallback in the SQL COALESCE — a non-TZS tenant that omits currency silently persists a TZS budget ceiling (CLAUDE.md never-hard-code-jurisdiction rule)
findings.issueClass: hard-coded jurisdiction in a code path / multi-currency hard-rule violation
findings.fileLine: services/api-gateway/src/routes/marketplace.hono.ts:352 (COALESCE(${body.currency ?? null}, 'TZS')); contradicted by the route comment at lines 339-340; DB column already DEFAULT 'TZS' at packages/database/src/migrations/0331_rfb_requests.sql:78
findings.proposedFix: Drop the SQL 'TZS' literal: omit the currency column from the INSERT when body.currency is absent so the column DEFAULT (or, better, a tenant-region-resolved value passed by the route) applies. Also correct the misleading comment, OR resolve the tenant region currency in the route rather than relying on a TZS default at all.
